# Weather Delay Escalation
For a confirmed carrier weather hold, open a carrier control-tower escalation. If the customer SLA is already breached, notify the customer within two hours and record the weather event as the supported root cause.

# Customs Review Procedure
For CUSTOMS_REVIEW, request or verify the broker document checklist and monitor the review. Do not claim customs rejection unless a rejection event exists.

# Unknown Delay Procedure
When a delay notice has no confirmed cause code, return **unknown root cause**, request a carrier root-cause update, and do not infer weather, capacity, customs, or address failure.

# Address Validation Procedure
For ADDR_CHECK, confirm the ship-to address with the customer master and carrier before reattempting delivery. Do not disclose finance-only records during this workflow.

# Mechanical Breakdown Procedure
For VEHICLE_BREAKDOWN, open carrier recovery, request replacement vehicle or reroute, recalculate ETA, and notify the customer if the ETA moves by more than four hours.

# Credit Hold Operational Policy
Operations must not dispatch an order while finance reports an active credit hold. The existence of a hold may be stated operationally only when the requesting role is authorized to read the underlying finance state; detailed reasons remain finance/manager data.
